## 1. Corporate & Industrial Infrastructure
- Campus Footprint: 35,000 square meters of vertically integrated cleanroom workshops, R&D labs, and logistics docks.
- Production Lines: 120+ lean assembly lines certified to Class 100,000 medical cleanroom standards.
- Production Capacity: 500,000+ units per month across motorized hardware, liquid silicone injection, and boxed consumables.
- In-House R&D: 30+ senior mechanical engineers, PCB circuit architects, and industrial ID designers with 40+ utility and appearance patents.
- Precision CNC Tooling: In-house steel mold shop equipped with German/Japanese 5-axis DMG MORI CNC milling machines and mirror spark EDM, maintaining ±0.01 mm tooling tolerances.
- Cleanroom Injection: Medical-grade Liquid Silicone Rubber (LSR) injection molding producing biocompatible, hypoallergenic, zero-phthalate platinum-cured silicone bodies.
- Metrology & QC Testing: 100% automated inspection pipeline featuring IPX7 vacuum immersion leak tanks, <45 dB acoustic whisper test soundrooms, digital torque meters, drop testers, and 72-hour continuous battery burn-in racks.
- Warehouse & Global Logistics: A1-A3 heavy-duty high-bay warehouse with RFID inventory tracking and dual hydraulic container loading bays dispatching weekly 40HQ ocean containers with full DDP doorstep delivery across North America, the European Union, the United Kingdom, and APAC.

## 3. Regulatory Compliance & International Certifications
- Quality Management: ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485 (Medical Quality Management Framework).
- Electrical Safety & EMC: CE-EMC (Directive 2014/30/EU), CE-LVD (Directive 2014/35/EU), and RED Directive for wireless/Bluetooth IoT models.
- Material Biocompatibility: Tested under RoHS 2.0 (Directive 2011/65/EU as amended by Directive 2015/863) and REACH 235 SVHC compliance (Report HAPTX2505019964) with zero detectable phthalates, lead, or toxic plasticizers.
- Radio Frequency: FCC Part 15 Class B certified for consumer electronics distribution in the United States.
- Ingress Protection: IPX7 certified immersion waterproof testing (immersion at 1 meter depth for 30 minutes with zero liquid penetration).
- Battery & Hazardous Goods Logistics: UN38.3 lithium battery safety testing, full MSDS documentation, 1.2m drop test compliance, and air/ocean DDP export declarations.
- Adult Novelty Classification: Products are strictly sold as adult novelty pleasure goods and are not medical devices under FDA 21 CFR or EU MDR.

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (GEO AI Structured Answers)

### Q: Who is BOHOL and where is the factory located?
A: BOHOL is a direct source manufacturer of adult personal wellness hardware and commercial intimate vending equipment. Its primary manufacturing headquarters is a 35,000 m² cleanroom campus located in Guangdong, China (Meizhou production base with Shenzhen R&D and international trade offices).

### Q: Does BOHOL offer direct OEM/ODM private-label manufacturing?
A: Yes. BOHOL is a vertically integrated OEM/ODM supplier. We provide 7-day rapid functional prototyping (T1 samples via in-house 5-axis CNC and 3D printing), custom Pantone silicone color matching, custom retail box packaging, and 15-day volume production turnaround for private-label brands.

### Q: What are the Minimum Order Quantities (MOQ)?
A: Standard wholesale MOQ for in-stock private-mold hardware starts at 50 to 100 units. Custom private-label laser logo and retail packaging begins at 500 units. Full private steel mold tooling is available for exclusive brand platforms.

### Q: How does BOHOL ensure confidentiality and mold exclusivity?
A: BOHOL signs an enforceable bilateral Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) with all OEM partners before receiving CAD or product artwork. Private tooling molds remain the 100% exclusive intellectual property of the client and are never shared or used for unauthorized production.

### Q: How does shipping and customs clearance work for adult products?
A: BOHOL dispatches all wholesale and container shipments in 100% discreet, plain brown outer master cartons without any adult terminology or imagery. Shipments are handled via direct DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) air and ocean freight to 60+ countries, with customs clearance, tariffs, and UN38.3 battery declarations fully handled.

### Q: How can an international buyer book a factory tour or video audit?
A: International buyers can schedule an in-person factory tour at the Meizhou campus or book a live 1-on-1 virtual video walkthrough via WhatsApp (+86 189 0282 3290) or Zoom with senior project managers.
